verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no data retention or deletion controls for Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud, such as retention windows, deletion endpoints, or purge settings. Opt-in audio recording, transcript collection, self-hosting and local inference are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a retention/deletion capability. The Cloud API's described scope (agents, secrets, builds, regions, organization settings) does not mention retention or deletion of session data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
